speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn presenting with a generalized rash; to help you, I need to ask a few questions. Has the rash appeared all at once, or has it spread over time, and are you experiencing any fever or feeding difficulties?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Gonococcal sepsis with disseminated gonococcal infection (DGI) causing a rash.
